map.提示：狼疮抗凝物(LA)名称虽含\"抗凝\"，但实际是促血栓抗体(体外延长凝血时: Note: despite the name 'anticoagulant', LA is actually a pro-thrombotic antibody (prolongs clotting time in vitro, promotes thrombosis in vivo). LA testing needs no anticoagulation or warfarin stopped 2 weeks prior; DOACs (direct oral anticoagulants) interfere. LA positivity needs repeat testing ≥12 wk apart to confirm persistence. LA is the strongest thrombosis predictor among the three APS antibodies. APS treatment is mainly long-term anticoagulation (warfarin/DOACs); catastrophic APS needs steroids + plasma exchange + IVIG. For clinical reference only.
